title: Entrance Fee Agreement Benefits Summary: Monthly Fee Adjustment and Care Discounts
content:
For residents and families: what holding an **Entrance Fee Agreement** does to the independent living monthly fee and to Larkspur assisted living and memory care charges, by refund plan.

| Refund plan | Adjustment to the independent living base monthly fee | Discount on assisted living care fees and memory care monthly rates | Discount on assisted living apartment rent | Agreement stays in force on a move to Larkspur assisted living or memory care on the campus |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| LifeChoice Declining Balance Plan | -12.0 percent | 10 percent | 10 percent | Yes |
| LifeChoice 50% Refundable Plan | -12.0 percent | 10 percent | 10 percent | Yes |
| LifeChoice 75% Refundable Plan | -12.0 percent | 10 percent | 10 percent | Yes |
| LifeChoice 90% Refundable Plan | -12.0 percent | 10 percent | 10 percent | Yes |
| LifeCare Declining Balance Plan | +9.0 percent | 100 percent | 25 percent | Yes |
| LifeCare 90% Refundable Plan | +9.0 percent | 100 percent | 25 percent | Yes |

A negative adjustment reduces the independent living base monthly fee and a positive one increases it. The care and rent discounts apply to a resident holding an occupied agreement.

## Points of comparison

- The four LifeChoice plans lower the monthly fee by 12.0 percent and discount care and rent by 10 percent.
- The two LifeCare plans raise the monthly fee by 9.0 percent, discount care fees and memory care monthly rates by 100 percent and discount assisted living rent by 25 percent.
- Under every plan the agreement remains in force when the resident moves to Larkspur assisted living or memory care on the campus.
